name: @migaia/storage-contract
description: Runtime-neutral storage contract: key-value store, codec, capability, context, key-domain and contract-level error types.

scripts.fmt: oxfmt src test README.md README.en.md USEGUIDE.md USEGUIDE.en.md package.json
scripts.build: node ../../scripts/dist-stamp.mjs clean && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ../../scripts/dist-stamp.mjs write
scripts.test: (node ../../scripts/dist-stamp.mjs assert || pnpm run build) && vitest run
